rejectionRules: Reject any object without a stable public URL, byte count, format, source checksum and recorded file-level rights decision.
Reject any object that references an undeclared specimen or lacks specimen ID, sex, spinal region, assay or source frame.
Reject coordinate unit, axis order, axis direction, origin or pixel-or-voxel scale only when an explicit missing reason is retained.
Reject any generic manifest that omits the preprint status or presents author-space coordinates as BrainGlobe space.
Reject any non-null local SHA-256 because this preflight does not acquire a file.
Reject any manifest that asserts downloaded, bundled, transformed or registered status.
